TopicStats.title: TopicStats
TopicStats.description: Right and wrong answer counters for a single OST Playbook topic.

correct.description: Total correct answers recorded for this topic.

wrong.description: Total wrong answers recorded for this topic.

TopicStatsMap.title: TopicStatsMap
TopicStatsMap.description: Per-topic right and wrong breakdown keyed by the 10 OST Playbook topic identifiers.

StudentProgress.title: StudentProgress
StudentProgress.description: Lifetime and per-topic Algebra 1 OST Playbook right/wrong progress for an authenticated student.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student owner.

displayName.description: Student display name from Google Sign-In.

lifetimeCorrect.description: Total lifetime correct answers across all OST Playbook topics.

lifetimeWrong.description: Total lifetime wrong answers across all OST Playbook topics.

topics.description: Map of all 10 OST Playbook topics tracking lifetime correct and wrong counts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student progress profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest recorded answer or profile sync.

/studentProgress/{userId}.description: Stores each signed-in student's lifetime and per-topic OST Playbook right/wrong statistics, readable and writable only by that authenticated student.
